result.description: A fictional pocket-sized NVMe key capsule built for encrypted document handoff, offline archives, and rapid workstation-to-workstation transfers. The Ledger 64GB uses a compact USB-C interface with a protective cap, prioritizing silent operation, low power draw, and consistent burst performance for small project files, signed PDFs, and audit bundles. Its matte shell is designed for discreet carry rather than rugged outdoor use, and the device is positioned as a secure everyday utility for office, legal, and studio workflows.
